title: sms_send_outcomes input
description: The input of the phone's sms_send_outcomes tool, as tools/list gives it (ADR-CVM-010). Passing a cursor acknowledges every outcome in the answer that gave it, and the dropped count that answer carried: only then does the phone delete them. It works as sms_since does.

cursor.description: The cursor from the last answer, passed back exactly as it came. It is opaque: the caller never reads it, compares it or builds one. Left out, or null, at the first call: the answer then starts at the oldest outcome the phone still keeps.
